baseline_exempt_reason: The tagged lines fire only on a skipped orphan stop, an opposite-side net, a fill with no average price or a held/unknown orphan stop outcome, which may not occur in the first session; normal paths are covered by tests/test_audit_1025.py and the exit-logic suite.
expected_rate: rare: only on mismatch or missing-price paths
window_reason: Error/mismatch-path change; the first full session proves the normal reconcile and stop paths are unchanged.
reversal: a position left without a stop it had before, a QHM or other-tier stop cancelled by orphan reconcile, or P&L booked at $0 or entry price without the unverified flag
